data.name: Bakkal Simulator
data.detailed_description:
The Degree is on the Wall, The Apron is on You. The Neighborhood is Watching.

After graduation, the corporate world stayed silent. Now, you stand before your grandfather’s old "Bakkal"—a traditional corner shop filled with dust and memories. Bakkal Simulator is a deep Narrative Simulation where you don't just manage a store; you become the heartbeat of a living, breathing community.

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Reputation System: Your relationship with the locals goes beyond transactions. Every "good morning," every credit you extend, and every price you set shapes your Social Reputation. Will you be the trusted cornerstone of the neighborhood, or the greedy shopkeeper they talk about behind your back?

  • Emergent Narrative Simulation: Stories in this world emerge from the interaction between the game’s physical and social systems. Your choices ripple through the community, creating a unique and unpredictable narrative path for every player.

  • The Social Hub: In this culture, a "Bakkal" is more than a shop. It's where secrets are kept and news is shared. Master the social dynamics to gain influence, help those in need, and manage the delicate balance of neighborhood life.

  • Atmospheric Immersion: From the tactile feeling of stocking shelves to the weight of the "Veresiye" (credit) ledger, every mechanic is designed to pull you deep into the life of a traditional shopkeeper.

You aren't just selling bread; you are weaving the fabric of a community. Are you ready to write your own story?

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Czech, Greek, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish*, Vietnamese, Azerbaijani

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 8th Gen
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 12th Gen
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains elements of theft that the player cannot directly commit (there is a chance for some NPCs to steal items from the shop) and mild violence against thieves (throwing stones or shoes) are present.
